d:
A colossal, demonic entity with jagged, obsidian black scales and massive, curved horns protruding from a skeletal head. Glowing, slit-like crimson eyes set into a monstrous, wide-jawed face. Massive, bat-like wings of deep violet membrane and a thick, spiked tail ending in a heavy obsidian club. Four sharp claws on each hand.
BODY COLOR: obsidian black
